question: Should the dashboard agent-status widget be accepted as a `sessions.list`-backed builtin in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826, or should it wait for the broader `sessions.activity.*` Gateway contract before this issue can be considered solved?
rationale: The requested UI is coherent, but the durable source of truth for current task, progress, attention, and cross-agent activity is still a product/API decision that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Keep as staged dashboard builtin
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the candidate UI solution, while requiring its review blockers and proof to clear before this issue closes.

options.title: Wait for activity contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open until the broader per-session activity contract lands, then implement the widget against that richer stable API.

options.title: Fold into roadmap tracker
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 own sequencing and close this issue only after its unique status-widget details are preserved there.

recommendation.title: Keep as staged dashboard builtin
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the candidate UI solution, while requiring its review blockers and proof to clear before this issue closes.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses Control UI plugin-tab product direction and session-status presentation on current main.
